thesis: Wingstop (Nasdaq: WING), 98% franchised chicken-wing chain. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-28) read in relevant sections. Q3 revenue 185.1M (+5.3%), system sales +6.0% to 1.4B, 76 net openings (3,331 restaurants), but domestic same-store sales -5.4% (-7.2% YTD); Adj EBITDA 64.0M (+0.5%); 9M NI 90.3M (-38.8% because 2025 had a 92.5M gain on investment sale). 9M OCF 129.6M, capex 47.5M (up from 24.6M), 13 restaurants bought from franchisees for 32.0M. Securitized notes 1,220.9M face (2.84%-~5%, leverage under 5.0x), cash 104.8M plus restricted 26.0M, equity deficit -772.5M. 9M buybacks 103.8M (Q3 avg 182.10), dividends 25.6M. Close 151.53 x 27.05M = 4.10B = 35.0x TTM NI 117.0M, TTM FCF 116.6M (2.8%), EV about 5.2B.
counterthesis: Valuation still requires growth that same-store sales declines are undermining; leverage ~1.2B securitized debt vs 130M cash with negative equity; buybacks at 182-245 were funded from cash and now cash fell 92M YTD; capex rising and company-restaurant purchases consume FCF. Stock already -14% since 11-09 and may keep derating if comps stay negative.
invalidation: Invalidated if same-store sales stay negative while unit growth slows, franchisee economics weaken (closures), or debt refinancing costs rise materially; conversely thesis for cheapness fails because it is not cheap on FCF.
